def get_player_pos():
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['pixels'] == 24:

            rows = [p[0] for p in b]
            cols = [p[1] for p in b]
            return (min(rows), min(cols))
    return None

pos = get_player_pos()

new_pos = get_player_pos()
print(f"SPACE: {pos} -> {new_pos}, moved={new_pos != pos}")

</parameter>
</function>
